nonAccrualCostPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, five of the Corporation's debt investments were on non-accrual status with a total cost of investment securities of $22.5 million and an aggregate fair value of $9.6 million, which represented 33.3% and 17.0% of the Corporation's investment portfolio, respectively.

nonAccrualFvPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, five of the Corporation's debt investments were on non-accrual status with a total cost of investment securities of $22.5 million and an aggregate fair value of $9.6 million, which represented 33.3% and 17.0% of the Corporation's investment portfolio, respectively.
